goal: As producer of 'Into the Woods' on Sep 15, 2025, rebuild the Sep 15-27 rehearsal schedule under the UCF Stage Management Handbook limits and venue conflicts, reconcile the budget and forecast cash flow, write an emergency Board memo (tranche recommendation, prioritized action items) and build a unified contact/compliance directory.
delivered: Four files: Revised_Rehearsal_Schedule.xlsx (Daily Schedule + Conflict Matrix, compliant with 23 h/week, weekend 7-of-8 h with meal break, one weekend day off), Budget_Reconciliation_Forecast.xlsx (Reconciliation, Cash Flow Forecast, reimbursements), Emergency_Board_Memo.docx and Contact_Compliance_Checklist.xlsx.
what_went_wrong: The budget workbook was written with openpyxl formulas and no cached values, so the judge saw blank Expense Detail Total, Variance, Remaining and Verification columns and blank Total Outflows/Net Change/Ending Cash in the cash-flow sheet. The schedule ignored choreographer Samira Hassan's 'Available Mon/Wed/Sat only' note, which root read directly and a subagent also reported, and put staging/runs on Tue/Thu/Fri. The Board memo had no Status column, no Sep 20 venue item, no production-team emergency-contact gap, and no analysis of spend rate or the upcoming costumes/lighting/sound/orchestra commitments.

failed_items.why: The roster's Production Team sheet says Choreographer Samira Hassan 'Available Mon/Wed/Sat only'. It appears in root's own read and in subagent d09afbb5's report, yet the Daily Schedule puts staging/transitions/Act II runs on Tue 9/16, Thu 9/18, Fri 9/19, Thu 9/25, Fri 9/26 and never mentions dance or the choreographer.

The Reconciliation sheet has formulas for Expense Detail Total (SUMIF), Variance, Remaining (=B-C) and Verification (=IF(ABS(E)<0.01,"MATCH","VARIANCE")) but no cached values (checked with openpyxl), so the judge saw 'Remaining is blank on every row' and no variance flag. The computed logic was correct.

The Cash Flow Forecast's Planned New Spend, Total Outflows, Net Change and Ending Cash are uncached formulas, so the judge saw blanks. Computed, ending cash would be negative in weeks 1-4 (about -284, -1,634, -3,383, -3,113), showing the gap. Explicit shortfall flags and a 'Board must cover' statement were also missing (minor M).

The memo states 30.1% utilization, the $2,625 vs $24,400 revenue gap and a conditional tranche recommendation, but gives no spend-rate-vs-timeline analysis and omits the uncommitted costumes $2,500, lighting $800, sound $1,200 and orchestra $1,800 that are in the budget tracker.

The memo's action table uses Priority/Owner/Action/Due with no Status column and has no Sep 20 Youth Soccer Banquet venue item. The Production Team's missing emergency contacts are not flagged anywhere: the directory leaves those cells blank with 'No personnel issue recorded'.

subagent_notes: Two subagents ('Inspect budget workbook', 'Inspect roster venue references') read the staged workbooks and reported accurately, including the choreographer's Mon/Wed/Sat-only availability and venue open slots. They helped with data extraction, but root did not act on the choreographer constraint. Each had minor tool errors (a bash call missing the 'description' argument; runc chdir failures to a non-existent workspace cwd) that they worked around without impact on the result.
